content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an incorrect configuration in the device tree source (DTS) file for the WSA881x audio components. Specifically, the powerdown GPIO pins were incorrectly assigned to GPIO2 and GPIO3 instead of the correct GPIO1 and GPIO2. This misconfiguration led to audio functionality being broken in the kernel version 5.13 after a fix in the GPIO driver was applied, which corrected a previous shift bug that allowed the incorrect pin assignments to work temporarily.
